description: Create a new prescription medication order. The patient must have completed intake questionnaire and consent before ordering. Required: medication name, selected form (injectable, tablet, drops), plan duration (1, 4, or 6 months), shipping address. The order is reviewed by a licensed US healthcare provider who makes the final prescribing decision. If approved, medication is compounded at a US-licensed 503A pharmacy and shipped directly to the patient. Returns order ID, estimated provider review time, and expected delivery window. Payment is processed via Stripe Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP). Requires authentication.

bearer_token.title: Bearer Token
